validationRules: Every category and subcategory must have a unique id.
Every slug must be unique within its applicable routing namespace.
Routes must match actual application pages.
relatedCourseIds must reference existing course records.
sortOrder must be a non-negative integer.
active and featured must be Boolean values.
Inactive categories must not appear in public navigation.
Featured categories must also be active.
Icons must use supported icon identifiers.
Do not publish links to pages that do not exist.
note: Category definitions organize MedOrbits navigation and content. Verify route availability, course references and icon support before enabling this configuration in production.
